Messages.Author: Salem
Messages.Body:
Just trying to get my head around the new rules.

So, I put 4 of my pool counters on my uncontrolled Jennifer.

At the end of my influence phase, she enters play with the 4 pool
counters representing 4 life, and I search through my library (or hand
or ash heap), find a Second Sight, and put it on her.

During my next untap phase, I've got another Second Sight in hand, so I
also put it on Jennifer.

During my minion phase, she takes a +1 stealth action (reduced to 0
stealth by her card text) to get a Project card. She burns a Second
Sight upon announcement to give monsters -1 intercept for this action.
No one blocks, and so she untaps. Next, she announces a bleed action at
-1 stealth and +1 bleed (from her card text), tapping the Project and
burning the other one of her Second Sights to pay for it, to make it
unblockable by vamps < 7 and monster allies < 4.

My prey loses 2 pool.

I have a tapped Jennifer, with a tapped Project on her.

Is this correct?

--

> My prey loses 2 pool.

Except for the part about meeting the requirements, I think it is.

Messages.Author: Fabio 'Sooner' Macedo
Messages.Body:
lactamaeon wrote:
> > During my next untap phase, I've got another Second Sight in hand, so I
> > also put it on Jennifer.
>
> Sure.

Just to be sure if I understood the Convinction rules right.

If I didn't had the 2nd Second (yiikes) Sight at hand, but I had one
copy in the ash heap, I could get it to put on Jennifer during my next
untap phase. Right?

So when an Imbued enters play, I can get one Conviction card on it from
wherever I want (library, hand, ash heap). And during my untap, I can
place another from my hand and ash heap. So we don't need to choke the
deck with these Convictions just to reliably draw them.

Sorry if it seems obvious, but the wording of the rule confused some
players I know (english as second language is always a problem in
here).

Fabio "Sooner" Macedo
